final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT il.InvoiceId AS InvoiceId, c.State AS State, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Invoice i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY il.InvoiceId, c.State), s2 AS (SELECT State, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1 GROUP BY State), s3 AS (SELECT s1.InvoiceId, s1.State, s1.cnt, (s1.cnt * 1.0) / s2.total AS q FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.State = s2.State COLLATE BINARY), s4 AS (SELECT State, AVG(q) AS avgq FROM s3 GROUP BY State) SELECT s3.InvoiceId, s3.State, s3.cnt, s3.q, s3.q - s4.avgq AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s3.State = s4.State COLLATE BINARY WHERE s3.q > s4.avgq ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
